title: Nazism and the Rise of Hitler
subtitle: Understanding the Weimar Republic, Hitler's Rise, and the World War II Era
subject: Social Science (History)
author: Antigravity Edu
learning_outcomes: Understand the impact of the First World War on Germany.
Analyze the structural weaknesses of the Weimar Republic.
Trace Hitler's rise to power and the destruction of democracy in Germany.
Examine the Nazi worldview and its catastrophic consequences.
Understand the role of youth and propaganda in Nazi Germany.

ai_context.learning_goal: The student must comprehend the socio-political factors that led to the rise of totalitarianism in Germany and the catastrophic impacts of Nazi ideology.
common_misconceptions: Hitler seized power purely by force (he legally became Chancellor before dismantling democracy).
Nazism was exactly the same as Italian Fascism (Nazism heavily emphasized race).
The Holocaust was the only event of World War II.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If the student struggles to understand why people supported Hitler, ask them to imagine living in a country with hyperinflation, massive unemployment, and national humiliation after a lost war.
